name: toucan
description: Draw diagrams on a live tldraw or Excalidraw canvas through the toucan CLI while a person watches and edits by hand.

interface.shortDescription: A canvas you and your agents share.
interface.longDescription: Draw diagrams of code, systems and plans on a live tldraw or Excalidraw canvas through the toucan CLI while a person watches and edits by hand: start from templates or describe a diagram as data, act on sticky notes and comment threads, and propose changes to accept or reject. Needs toucan installed: curl -fsSL https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
defaultPrompt: Use toucan to draw how this repo fits together, and open it for me.
Handle the sticky notes I left on the canvas.
What's missing from this diagram? Answer as a proposal.
